subject: FLAG-14 directive
notes: cite.py --check 7.3.15.4 'If the FLAG-14 directive is not specified, the default for all options is off' OK. FlagState.IsOnAt starts from on=false and FlagState.Empty covers no directive at all. FlagScanState.IsOn returns false for an option it has never seen. FlagConformancePass.Run returns before walking when !flag.Any. Every probe program shows warnings only after a directive, and a FLAG-02 event never touches a FLAG-14 option (Fold_All_FansOutToEveryOptionOfThatDirectiveOnly). Unit tests Compile_NoDirective_EmitsNoFlagWarning and Fold_DefaultsOff_AndIsStickyForwardStrictlyAfterTheDirective derive their expected values from GR5.
